comment: Five of the eleven declared parameters have no widget on the panel and cannot be clicked: TRIG_PARAM, GATE_PARAM and the three STOR entries. The right input is read without the gain multiplier when it has its own cable but with it when it falls back to the left. dataToJson writes each of the 48000 samples of both buffers as a separate JSON key. Playback steps the read index by oct each sample, oct being 1 plus the switch's 0 to 3 plus 1 more while the OCT jack is above 1V, so the rate multiplier runs 1 to 5. The breakpoint machinery inherited from StochKit is multiplied by zero in this build and contributes nothing.
